messages:
Sofia Patel: Heads-up company-wide: SOC2/ISO evidence intake is open and privacy attestation is required. Key dates: privacy attestation due 2024-05-01; internal evidence deadline 2024-05-08; contractors/partners 2024-05-12. Auditor: Meridian Audit Co. Portal: https://compliance.internal.redwood/submit (choose '2024 Evidence Intake').

Rajesh Kumar: Quick ask: what counts as proof for MFA enforcement on service accounts?

Sofia Patel: We need either an IAM policy export showing conditional MFA rules or a screenshot of the service-account policy + a short ticket describing mitigation if full MFA isn't possible. If using service tokens, include rotation schedule screenshots.

Mei Wong: For databases, can we upload redacted exports or do you need architecture diagrams too?

Sofia Patel: Redacted exports are fine. Also include a brief README that states retention window, anonymization/hashing method (if used), and the restore-test ticket. Please do NOT include raw PII.

Evan Brooks: Note for infra teams: follow filename convention RDW_EVID_<team>_<artifact>_<YYYYMMDD>_<owner>. Example: RDW_EVID_platform_IAM_20240418_evan.b@redwood.com. Tag uploads in portal with 'SOC2-2024' and link any tickets.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: Privacy attestation 'Handling Customer Data' assigned to all employees. Deadline 2024-05-01. Managers will see a report on 2024-05-02.

compliance-bot: Automated: 7 days until internal evidence deadline (2024-05-08). You have 2 outstanding items in the portal. Queue: https://compliance.internal.redwood/queue

Rajesh Kumar: Some contractors are in APAC with travel windows. Can vendor liaison request extensions?

Sofia Patel: Yes, vendor liaisons can request a 3-day extension per-case. Submit extension requests via ticket (label: EXT-SOC2-2024) before 2024-05-08.

Mei Wong: Is there a central checklist?

Sofia Patel: Short checklist in portal and Confluence: 1) IAM role exports/screenshots; 2) S3/bucket policy export or equivalent; 3) Redacted DB export + restore ticket; 4) Example app logs (redacted) for the audit window; 5) Training attestation screenshot; 6) MFA or token rotation proof for service accounts. Full guide: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/COMPLIANCE/2024+Evidence+Intake

Evan Brooks: If teams hit blockers, open a ticket and tag me or @Sofia. We'll run a quick intake review to avoid rework.

Sofia Patel: Thanks everyone. Compliance team will compile submissions and share a confirmation list with Meridian on 2024-05-09. If you have any questions DM me. :white_check_mark:
